gloss: period of stay; length of stay; duration of visit

definitions.gloss: period of stay; length of stay; duration of visit
definitions.explanation: The amount of time one stays in a particular place, often used in the context of travel, immigration, or hotel stays.

examples.japanese: {滞在期間|たいざいきかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧です。
examples.english: The period of stay is one week.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{滞在期間|たいざいきかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to extend the period of stay on my visa.

examples.japanese: {滞在期間|たいざいきかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{短|みじか}かった→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: My stay was short, so I couldn't do much sightseeing.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{滞在|たいざい}→滞在：03390_taizai⟧ (stay, sojourn) + ⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (period, duration). Commonly used in travel, immigration, and accommodation contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {滞在期間|たいざいきかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to extend the period of stay
- {滞在期間|たいざいきかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: for the stay period to expire
- {滞在期間|たいざいきかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to exceed the allowed stay period
- ⟦{最長|さいちょう}→最長：13076_saichou⟧{滞在期間|たいざいきかん}: maximum period of stay

USAGE:
Frequently encountered in visa applications, hotel booking forms, and immigration-related documents. Also used informally when discussing travel plans.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{滞在|たいざい}→滞在：03390_taizai⟧: stay, sojourn — the act of staying itself
- {在留期間|ざいりゅうきかん}: period of residence — used specifically for immigration/visa contexts in Japan
